findings.text: The fixture test computes wall scores through topology._wall_events and then applies topology.extremum_index itself, so it never exercises the _read_at_nulls wall-index selection (topology.py:3445 and :3463) the change edited; reverting either call site to jnp.argmax would leave every assertion green, which leaves the product wiring unguarded.

extremum_index restates deterministic first-extremum selection that nova/equilibrium/connectivity_boundary.py:130 already owns as _arg_extreme with _argmax_exact and _argmin_exact wrappers; the tolerance branch is genuinely new but the exact branch duplicates an owner the module already imports from.

extremum_index returns -1 when every admitted score is NaN, and x_point_data uses that index directly as vmap_x[index], so an all-NaN admitted set now selects the last candidate where jnp.nanargmax selected the first; the degenerate state is untested and the -1 is unmasked at the call site.

item_verdicts.call_sites: The runtime paths reaching the change are topology.py's read, read_with_connectivity, read_qualification, update, qualified_o_candidates and read_at_stationary_points/refresh_at_stationary_points, plus support_read._normal_ring_rates through the solve tangent.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against b48deaa93: ba23b17df adds the helper and rewires 15 rankings plus the new test file, and b9ca3cd7b adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for the rule plus three tests, a negative control, paired base/head files in one 7-CPU sirius job and a fragment; tests/test_read_tie_break.py carries the three cases, negative-control.log is the plain-argmax run, paired.sh is the single job and docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/read-tie-break.html lists the decisions and the rule.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is a stated deterministic rule for near-tied read candidates shared by every tied decision; nova/equilibrium/topology.py:56 implements it and the 15 converted rankings in topology.py and support_read.py use it.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reads complete at b9ca3cd7b2ee with the paired arms, the negative control and the final-head tie run recorded, and its stated counts reconcile with the log summaries I read.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares topology.py, support_read.py, tests/test_read_tie_break.py and the fragment; every path changed across the two commits is one of those four.

justifications.durability: tests/test_read_tie_break.py:82 drives topology.extremum_index directly over independently computed scores, so the exact-tie and fixture assertions redden on a plain-argmax regression (negative-control.log shows 2 failed) but no assertion exercises the product call sites the change edited, so reverting any one of them to jnp.argmax stays green.
justifications.evidence: The done_when's one-sirius-job, one-process-per-file pair is real: paired.sh requests --cpus-per-task=7 and paired-slurm.log ends ALL_SIX_ARMS_COMPLETE, with base-tracked.log 15 passed EXIT=0, head-tracked.log 15 passed EXIT=0, base-support.log and head-support.log both 13 passed 2 skipped EXIT=0, head-ties.log 7 passed EXIT=0 and negative-control.log 2 failed EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/topology.py:56 reads in the module's own idiom — a module-level pure jnp helper beside x_point_height_limits with a mechanism docstring, no plan or ticket identifiers, and a descriptive name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/topology.py:56 adds the relative-1e-12 lowest-canonical-index rule and all 15 floating-point rankings in topology.py and support_read.py call it while the 10 Boolean first-true lookups stay exact.
justifications.reuse: The tolerance rule has no owner, but nova/equilibrium/connectivity_boundary.py:130 already owns deterministic first-extremum selection as _arg_extreme with _argmax_exact/_argmin_exact wrappers, and topology.py already imports private names from that module, so the exact branch of any new helper could have extended it rather than restating it.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff touches only nova/equilibrium/topology.py, nova/equilibrium/support_read.py, tests/test_read_tie_break.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
